row.notes: Serialises the whole ERS data section, not one mode (corrected per V1241): from MaxDeployPower data+0x10 (system+0x28) through the top-level constants (MaxDeratePower, BoostModePowerAddLimit, PowerReductionRateLimit, throttle timers, HarvestTorqueFactor, HarvestLimitMGUK, DeployLimit), EnergyStoreCapacity, the efficiencies, the splines and the ES/MGUK wear, then 4 mode blocks of stride 0x40 (Name, First..EighthGearModifier, DerateStartSpeed): three via 0x1446cf330 at data+0x1868/+0x18a8/+0x18e8, the fourth inline at +0x1928. Its signature id car.parse_energy_recovery_mode is historical and misleading: the signature targets this whole-section writer. Correction: this is the serialiser (component data vtable slot 3): it writes the section back as XML through the writer object's vtable (+0x28 begin element, +0x68 attribute, +0x78 end, +0x98 comment); the field list above is what it writes. The reader is slot 2 (Car_Read_EnergyRecovery, Game_Read_VtfFloat by name, plain floats). | car-b: data vtable slot 3 (vtable entry 0x145bfdb08). Capstone cross-check: it reads the same data offsets the paired Car_Read_ function writes (differences only in vector internals, derived fields and ERS TrackSettings, which are not written back), so the struct offsets in the car-b structs hold for both
